title: Exact dual-producer shared-mesh physical calibration
hypothesis: A compact physical harness containing the complete 112-context VC0 service, complete four-group exact VC1 reduction path, one shared 4x4 mesh, sixteen held-grant VC arbiters, exact c16/r2/l8/b59 tree, and 120 SRAM macros can replace separately costed transport components with a hierarchy-matched Nangate45 anchor.

direct_comparison.primary_question: What timing, reusable-DUT area, and whole-harness power bounds result when the exact Llama7B VC0 and VC1 producer paths share one embodied mesh?
include: four sequential VC1 groups, 1260 packets, 10020 flits, and 512 exact root rows
one noc_segmented_mesh4x4 and sixteen noc_endpoint_vc_injection_arbiter instances
disjoint hierarchical area for the VC0 service, VC1 exact path, and shared transport
exclude: claiming activity stimulus as reusable DUT area
claiming vectorless whole-harness power as token energy
changing Llama7B arithmetic precision or quality

required_evaluations.objective: Measure flat and hierarchy-preserving Yosys feasibility before launching the composed OpenROAD canary.
required_evaluations.acceptance_notes: Preserve both mode rows and all failures. This is resource/legality evidence, not PPA. Keep 120 fakeram instances as blackboxes and do not run physical postchecks.

required_evaluations.objective: Measure composed shared-mesh timing, area, and power using the viable synthesis decomposition.
required_evaluations.acceptance_notes: Launch only after the synth prefilter chooses a viable monolithic or hardened-RTL-macro decomposition. Require finite PPA, timing-path identity, exactly 120 SRAM macros, and the disjoint three-prefix area sum.

remaining_abstractions: HBM/DRAM controller and off-chip service remain external by design.
Whole-harness vectorless power is an upper bound until workload activity is propagated into physical power analysis.
The composed point does not become a Llama7B frontier point until physical metrics are fed back into the architecture model.
